# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore release notes — captured 2026-08-09
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (sources.json still points at doc-history.html, which renders title/nav only — recurring since
#  2026-05-18 and still unfixed)

## August 2026
- Memory, policy, and harness are now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West) `us-gov-west-1`.  [NEW
  since the 2026-08-07 capture — REGION EXPANSION, held below the reporting bar: no new entity type,
  API or capability. Runtime, gateway, identity, built-in tools, observability and evaluations were
  already available in the Region.]
- Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers.        [reported 2026-08-07]
- AWS Agent Registry launches under the `agent-registry` namespace. [reported 2026-08-07]
- Gateway: Configurable rate limits.                              [reported 2026-08-07]

## July 2026 — all reported 2026-08-07
Gateway Web Search connector v1.2.0; Identity Private Key JWT; Harness InvokeHarness streams MCP
tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination; Evaluations/Optimizations PrivateLink;
Evaluations expanded framework support; ActiveSessionCount metric; Runtime default quota increase.

## June 2026 and earlier — previously reported
Web Search Tool GA; Policy + Bedrock Guardrails; Harness GA; Recommendations GA; Batch Evaluations
GA; A/B Testing GA; Managed Knowledge Base GA; Failure Insights preview; Gateway Runtime targets GA,
HTTP passthrough targets, inference targets, inbound traffic enforcement; SOC compliance; Identity
Secrets Manager references; CLI/CDK payments support; Runtime Interactive Shells; Step Functions
integration.

## Data-plane Actions list (API_Operations.html) — IDENTICAL to the 2026-08-07 capture
Still the only registry op on this page is SearchRegistryRecords; DeleteCapacityProviderSession
remains the newest addition. Payments, A/B testing, Recommendation, Memory, Browser, Code
Interpreter, Auth/Token, Events groups all unchanged.

## Developer guide overview (what-is-bedrock-agentcore.html) — unchanged
Core services: Harness, Runtime, Memory, Gateway, Identity, Code Interpreter, Browser,
Observability, Payments (x402), Evaluations, Optimization, Policy, Registry. All previously reported.

Updated: 2026-08-09 — one new August entry (GovCloud region expansion), held below bar.
